title: Quello che il potere non dice
author: Chora Media - Chiara Albanese
description:
Ogni giorno leggiamo le dichiarazioni dei politici, seguiamo gli scontri tra i partiti e ascoltiamo le promesse di chi ci governa. Ma che cosa succede davvero dietro le quinte della politica? Come si arriva alle decisioni che cambiano le nostre vite? E che cosa resta fuori dai racconti ufficiali?


Quello che il potere non dice prova a rispondere a queste domande attraverso le voci di chi il potere lo esercita o lo conosce da vicino. Ogni settimana Chiara Albanese, giornalista di Bloomberg News, incontra uno dei protagonisti della politica e delle istituzioni italiane per andare oltre le dichiarazioni pubbliche e i titoli dei giornali.


Al centro delle conversazioni ci sono le scelte che riguardano il Paese, gli interessi che le condizionano, i rapporti personali e politici che contano quando bisogna decidere. Le interviste partono dall'attualità e si confrontano con fatti, numeri e promesse, per capire che cosa funziona, che cosa non funziona e quali conseguenze hanno le decisioni di chi governa.


Uno sguardo sulla politica raccontata da chi la fa, con le domande di chi cerca di capire che cosa si nasconde dietro le parole del potere.


Quello che il potere non dice è un video podcast di Chora Media realizzato in collaborazione con Bloomberg News.

Hosted by Johanna Buchweitz, Frankly explores the human side of ambition and the stories behind the people building meaningful lives and businesses.


Through honest conversations with founders, leaders, creatives, entrepreneurs, and people navigating their own unexpected paths, we talk about what doesn't always make it onto the résumé or into the boardroom: ambition, uncertainty, failure, identity, money, relationships, parenthood, grief, reinvention, and the moments that force us to rethink what we're building—and why.


Because business is personal.

title: Thrive Solo
author: Lucy Meggeson
description:
Let’s be real — being single and child-free? It’s pretty damn awesome. Don’t believe me? Stick around. I promise you, by listening to this podcast, you’re going to start seeing your solo life in a whole new light — one that feels empowering, exciting, and full of possibility.

I’m Lucy Meggeson, and I’m here to help you stop seeing singlehood as a consolation prize and start embracing it as the incredible opportunity that it is. Because the truth? Being single isn’t second best. It’s not a waiting room. And it sure as hell isn’t a life of lack. In fact, when you lean into it, it can be just as fulfilling—if not more so—than being coupled up with kids.

And besides, no matter what our relationship status, what we all really want is to feel good in the here and now. So instead of focusing on what’s ‘missing,’ let’s focus on what’s possible. The freedom. The adventure. The extra time and headspace to create a life that’s truly our own.

Because here’s the thing: you are so much more powerful than you realise. Your thoughts shape your reality. And when you shift your mindset, you shift your life. My mission isn’t just to help you feel better about being single—it’s to help you recognise your own agency. To help you see that you are the creator of your own experience. And that you, and you alone, get to decide what your life looks like.

So join me here every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday, and let’s build lives that feel joyful, meaningful, and wildly fulfilling — on our own terms.

Let’s Thrive Solo…together.

Their backgrounds couldn't be more different, but what began as an unexpected meeting became a lasting friendship. Despite their very different perspectives, they share a genuine desire to help the people and families they work with.

Still Unanswered grew from that friendship.


Theresa Michaels has spent more than three decades in real estate and pioneered the real-estate niche now known as crime and stigmatized properties - homes connected to tragedy and circumstances far outside the ordinary. description:
Her New Christian Walk Podcast 
Do you feel stuck in your mind, exhausted from overthinking, and unsure of who God created you to be?
You want to grow closer to God, find your purpose, and move forward in life. But you keep second-guessing yourself, putting things off, and wondering, “Why can’t I just stay consistent?”
You start with good intentions, get overwhelmed, and find yourself starting over again. You want to take action, but don’t know where to start.
Same here love.
I’m Daritza, a mom and entrepreneur learning how to walk with God one step at a time. When I came to faith, I knew God was calling me to something more, but I felt stuck, overwhelmed, inconsistent, and constantly trapped in my own thoughts.
This podcast is me figuring it out out loud with God, His Word, and you.
Each week, we’ll talk about overthinking, faith, renewing your mind, identity in Christ, purpose, procrastination, consistency, and self-doubt. We’ll explore how to take simple God-led steps in your faith, your goals, and your everyday life, even when you don’t have it all figured out yet.
No pretending. No perfect plans. Just real conversations, biblical encouragement, and practical steps to help you follow through on what matters while growing closer to Jesus.
So grab your Bible, your journal, and your coffee. We’re growing through this together.
montieldaritza@gmail.com

title: ForgeIsland
author: Adam Kane
description:
Forge Island is a game being built almost entirely by AI agents. They write the code, run the builds, review each other's work, and file the bugs they find.

Every few hours a fresh account of that work becomes an episode: what the agents shipped, what broke, and what changed because of it. No roadmap theatre and no launch hype. Just the machine talking about the machine, including the parts that went badly.

If you want to know what it actually looks like when software is written by a fleet of agents instead of a team of people, this is the log.

title: The New Kid Podcast
author: Partners in UpBringing and Raising Confident Readers
description:
Every child has a story. All they need is a little encouragement and a microphone!
Welcome to The New Kid Podcast, where children WRITE and NARRATE their own stories, sharing their imagination, experiences and unique perspectives.
With GUIDANCE FROM EXPERTS, our young storytellers find their voice and share it with the world. These are stories that will make you laugh, wonder and think!
Have a young storyteller at home? We'd love to invite them to BE OUR NEXT YOUNG PODCASTER. To find out how, write to us on upbringing.podcast@gmail.com or WhatsApp Kalyani on +65 94462751.

title: The Sat Shah Show: Vancouver Sports
author: The Sick Podcast
description:
The Sat Shah Show powered by Sick Media is the sickest Vancouver sports show! Hosted by one of Vancouver’s most recognizable sports personalities, Sat brings his unfiltered takes, big opinions, high-energy breakdowns, and special guests covering Vancouver sports and national sports storylines, with a special focus on the Canucks. Live M-F at 4PM PT and live post-game shows after every Vancouver Canucks game!

title: Still the Weekend Podcast
author: Still the Weekend Podcast
description: Sean and David host Still the Weekend Podcast. Bringing you back to the good ol' days of Friday night gaming sessions that lasted until Sunday. Having pizza and too much pop while you try and beat the final boss with your friends, and those Monday morning conversations in the school yard about how great the weekend was, just waiting for the next. It might be a Monday where you are, but when you're hanging with Sean and David, it's Still the Weekend!

title: The Honeybuzz Hour
author: Bee Lors
description: The HoneyBuzz Hour is a lively, feel-good podcast where Honeybuzz and friends explore machine learning, emerging technology, cybersecurity, sustainability, and smart everyday choices. Through playful interviews and fresh perspectives, the show makes complex tech topics approachable—bringing practical insights, digital safety tips, and plenty of buzz from the hive.

title: One More Nine
author: Brant Gillespie
description: One More Nine with Brant Gillespie is a golf podcast built around the moments that keep you coming back. From major championships and the latest in the game to the everyday rounds with your friends, this show is all about golf, the stories behind it, and the mindset that comes with it. Whether you’re chasing lower scores or just looking for one more loop, this is your place for real conversations about the game.

title: The Window Seat
author: Skye Robbie
description:
The Window Seat is an interview series where host Skye Robbie sits down with filmmakers, storytellers, locals and adventurers who have explored the world far beyond the guidebooks.

Guests share unforgettable travel stories, their highest highs and lowest lows, and valuable insights into how they built a life of freedom, so you can too.

Whether you’re looking for inspiration for your next destination, practical advice, or to be mentally transported into the wildest of encounters, The Window Seat is your ticket to a world of adventure.

Subscribe for new episodes every week.

title: Saved By The Bell
author: Moya Lothian-McLean
description:
Hello, this is Saved By The Bell, a soon-to-be weekly podcast from the team behind The Bell, Glasgow's newest and most ambitious newspaper. Join Calum, Robbie and Beth to go behind the scenes of their biggest stories and discuss the city's top talking points. If you've got any interest in Glasgow, or its surrounding areas, tune in. And to read all our stories, head to glasgowbell.co.uk.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Late-Night Parent Club
author: MadeForMums
description:
Still awake? You're in good company. 
 
The Late-Night Parent Club is the parenting podcast for the questions that keep you up at night, hosted by Minah Shannon and brought to you by MadeForMums. 
 
From sleepless nights and newborn worries to relationships, mental health and the everyday chaos of raising children, Minah is joined by parenting experts and real parents for honest conversations, practical advice and a little reassurance along the way. 
 
No question is too awkward, no worry too small and no parenting experience off limits. 
 
Whether you're feeding a baby at 2am, folding washing, or finally enjoying five minutes to yourself, pull up a chair. You're part of the club. 
 
New episodes every Tuesday and Thursday at 11pm. 
 
The Late-Night Parent Club is a MadeForMums podcast, published by Immediate.

title: Clutch Justice: The Podcast
author: Rita Williams
description:
The official podcast of Clutch Justice, where the story doesn't end with the official version.
Hosted by investigative journalist Rita Williams, Clutch Justice: The Podcast takes listeners beyond the headlines and into the courtrooms, case files, public records, and unanswered questions that deserve a closer look.
From unsolved murders and forgotten cold cases to judicial misconduct, government accountability, and institutional failures, each episode follows the evidence, challenges the narrative, and examines what happens when the people and institutions entrusted with justice fall short.

title: The Filtered life
author: iamrachelriley; makeupbyxvanessa
description:
From the outside, everyone looks like they’ve got it together - the glow, the gloss, the polished life. But behind it? There’s always more going on than you think. 
The Filtered Life is a funny, honest podcast from Cheshire based Vanessa and Rachel about navigating life in your 30s: relationships, friendships, careers, motherhood, beauty, anti-ageing, social media and everything in between. 
Expect unfiltered conversations, oversharing, plenty of laughs and the things everyone’s thinking but nobody’s saying. Our faces may be filtered… Our voices aren’t!

title: The Life of John Wesley Hardin (As Written by Himself)
author: John Wesley Hardin
description:
John Wesley Hardin, a name that echoes through the annals of the Wild West, takes center stage in his own gripping memoir. Known as one of the most notorious gunfighters of his era, Hardin's life was a whirlwind of violence, rivalry, and survival in a time when lawlessness reigned. In this raw and unfiltered autobiography, he recounts his journey from a troubled youth to a feared figure, revealing the motivations behind his infamous reputation and the conflicts that shaped his existence.

As listeners delve into his story, they’ll discover not just the man behind the legend, but also the societal forces driving a culture of violence. Hardin’s candid narrative challenges perceptions and offers a unique glimpse into the mind of someone who lived on the edge. From notorious shootouts to personal vendettas, each chapter unpacks the complexities of his character and the harsh realities of frontier life.

While Hardin's words may reflect the prejudices of his time, they paint a vivid picture of the struggles and tensions that defined his world. This audiobook invites listeners on an unforgettable journey through a turbulent life, asking them to confront the darker aspects of human nature and the consequences of a life led by the gun. Join Hardin as he unapologetically shares his truth, revealing the man behind the myth in a way that few have dared to explore.

title: Come Sit Down
author: Liza
description: Come Sit Down is where we talk Jesus, real life, hard questions, and the stuff that might make you a little uncomfortable. Hosted by Liza — mom of three, nurse becoming a social worker, DV survivor, and runner — this is a podcast for churchgoers who sit in sermons and sing the worship songs but wonder what any of it has to do with Monday. Every week: real gospel conversations with soapbox energy. Sometimes comfort, sometimes conviction. You might get called out. You'll definitely get Scripture. Open your Bible, check your heart, and come sit down.

title: gentle—noise
author: gentle—noise
description:
Conversations on spiritual practice in contemporary culture, hosted by Manoj Dias.


Season 1: New Episodes every Tuesday.


Conversations. Artists, teachers, and thinkers on the practices behind their work.


Field Notes. Short solo episodes episodes on practice, frameworks and contemplative philosophy.

title: The Biology of Everything
author: Aliya
description: The Biology of Everything explores the science of life through the fascinating processes, hidden connections, and natural phenomena that shape our world. From the microscopic organisms living around us to the complex systems that allow plants, animals, and humans to survive, each episode reveals a different side of biology in an accessible and engaging way. Discover how everyday habits connect to human biology, how living organisms adapt to changing environments, and how small biological processes can have remarkable effects on the world around us. Designed for curious minds, this podcast turns scientific questions into engaging stories and makes the wonders of life easier to understand. Whether exploring the intelligence of plants, the diversity of ecosystems, or the remarkable abilities of the human body, The Biology of Everything invites listeners to look at the living world with fresh curiosity.

title: The Audacity of Mothers
author: Slone and Chelsea
description:
We’re here to talk about the things we’re told not to say out loud. The mental load. The double standards. The rage. The guilt. The politics. The relationships. The existential crises in the Target parking lot. And all the weird, wonderful, woo-woo shit that gets us through it.

This is a space for big feelings, uncomfortable truths, unapologetic opinions, and the kind of conversations that make you feel a little less crazy and a lot less alone.

title: All In Collective
author: All In Collective
description: The All In Collective Podcast brings real conversations about inclusion, disability, advocacy, parenting, education, and community to the table. We’ll share lived experiences, helpful resources, family perspectives, and conversations with advocates, educators, professionals, and community leaders. We’ll celebrate the wins, talk honestly about the challenges, and keep working toward communities where everyone belongs. Because inclusion is more than being invited—it’s being valued, supported, and truly included. Real conversations. A more inclusive tomorrow.

title: Traveling with a Martini
author: Wanda Bryant
description:
Welcome to Traveling with a Martini, a Stylus & Suitcases podcast where every destination has a story.


Join storyteller Wanda Bryant as she takes you along on a collection of real-life travel adventures filled with unexpected detours, unforgettable encounters, fabulous discoveries, and the occasional moment when everything goes hilariously wrong.


From wandering European streets and navigating unfamiliar cities to memorable meals, chance encounters, and lessons learned along the way, these aren't your typical travel guides. They're stories about the experiences that stay with us long after the suitcases are unpacked.


With humor, heart, a little attitude, and the perspective that comes from a lifetime of adventures, Traveling with a Martini reminds us that sometimes the best travel stories are the ones we never planned.


Pour yourself something wonderful, settle in, and enjoy the journey.

title: ONSTAGE/OFF
author: Meaghan & Steve
description:
ONSTAGE/OFF is a podcast celebrating the Performing Arts, and the artists behind the performances. Theater, Dance, Music, and Comedy. What are your favorite (or soon-to-be favorite) artists like when they’re off stage? How did they get started? What are their dreams, fears, and biggest wins they’ve had on stage? 
ONSTAGE/OFF explores the real people, real talent and real stories in Charlotte, NC and Beyond.

title: The Burning Lamps Revival
author: alan.crookham
description: This is the podcast for The Burning Lamps. A revival movement based on intercessors around the world seeking God for a nation-changing move.

title: The Football Afterglow
author: August
description: The Football Afterglow explores the emotions, stories, and experiences that remain long after the final whistle. From the bond between supporters and their clubs to the pressure of life-changing matches, this podcast looks beyond goals and trophies to discover what football truly means to the people who live and breathe the game. Each episode offers a fresh perspective through stories of legendary players, club traditions, memorable rivalries, unexpected turning points, and the personal sacrifices behind sporting success. Whether exploring the atmosphere of a historic stadium or examining how one match can change a player's future, The Football Afterglow celebrates the human side of football and the memories that stay with us long after the game ends.

title: Leading With Purpose
author: Marnesia
description: Leading With Purpose explores transformational, transactional, servant, situational, and authentic leadership through relatable workplace examples. Hosted by Marnesia Jones, this episode examines each approach’s characteristics, strengths, challenges, and best uses to show how leaders can respond thoughtfully to their teams’ needs.

title: Catalytic Capital
author: Ken Kurtzig
description: Welcome to Catalytic Capital, the podcast where philanthropy meets innovation. Hosted by Ken Kurtzig, this series explores how philanthropic capital is driving bold ideas, inspiring stories, and empowering the changemakers shaping our world. Through thought-provoking conversations with impact investors, visionary entrepreneurs, and philanthropic leaders, we uncover how donations can act as catalytic investments—fueling enterprises that create a better, more sustainable future.

title: Pitchside Stories
author: Smith
description: Pitchside Stories is a cricket podcast exploring the moments, rivalries, strategies, and unforgettable stories that make cricket more than just a game. From historic matches and remarkable performances to the pressure of the final over, every episode takes listeners closer to the action and the people behind it. Discover the evolution of cricket, the importance of teamwork, the challenges players face, and the moments that have shaped the sport across generations. Whether you follow international cricket, enjoy the excitement of T20 leagues, or appreciate the traditions of Test cricket, Pitchside Stories brings the spirit of the game to life through engaging discussions and original storytelling.

title: Arizona Diamondbacks Weekly
author: Mike Michaelson
description:
Weekly news from the Arizona Diamondbacks

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Space Dump Baddie Podcast
author: Space Dump Baddies
description: A podcast for women by women, in our episodes, we will cover everything that has been taboo or discouraged from being discussed, from perimenopause to sexual assault. We hold space for rage, healing, and conscious discussion.

title: Inside Out Health
author: Tara Garrison
description:
Inside Out Health is a top 1% global podcast exploring transformation across the full spectrum of human health—body, brain, behavior, identity, and consciousness—while recognizing that true health is shaped not only from within, but by the environment and world around us.
Hosted by Tara Garrison, the show features conversations with physicians, performance experts, and thought leaders across health, human optimization, and regenerative and integrative approaches. Each episode connects physiology, psychology, and deeper work to explore what actually drives lasting change—from the inside out.

title: The Giant Horse of Oz (Quest to Save Ozure Isles)
author: Ruth Plumly Thompson
description:
When a dreadful monster named Quiberon threatens the peaceful kingdom of the Ozure Isles, the stakes couldn't be higher. After two decades of terror, the beast demands a mortal maiden as tribute, leaving the inhabitants in a desperate scramble. But in the whimsical Land of Oz, where adventure thrives, mortal maidens are a rare find. Enter Dorothy Gale, Betsy Bobbin, and Trot, three brave girls determined to save their friends and family from Quiberon's wrath.

Join Tattypoo, the Good Witch of the North, as she weaves her magic and guides our heroes through a series of enchanting and perilous escapades. From the mysterious Cave City to the peculiar Roundabouties and the elusive Shutterfaces, each location unveils new wonders and challenges. With clever twists, unexpected alliances, and a dash of humor, the quest becomes not just about survival, but also about friendship, courage, and the power of believing in the extraordinary.

Giant Horse of Oz invites listeners of all ages to experience a captivating tale filled with mythical creatures, daring adventures, and the timeless charm of Oz. Will our heroes find a way to confront Quiberon and restore peace to their kingdom? Embark on this thrilling journey, where every twist and turn promises a delightful surprise.

title: $5 and a Dream Sports Gambling Podcast
author: Damarcio McCoy
description: $5 and a Dream is a sports gambling podcast built for bettors who know you don’t have to risk big money to have some fun and chase a win.  Each episode breaks down daily picks across football, basketball, baseball and more, including player props, alternate lines, spreads, moneylines, team totals, over/unders and parlays.  The idea is simple: small bets, bigger plans. I’m putting together the plays I like, explaining what I see, and building $5 parlays without pretending there’s such a thing as a guaranteed bet.  Whether you’re looking for another opinion before locking in your picks, trying to find a few legs for tonight’s parlay, or just love talking sports and betting, come along for the ride.  $5 AND A DREAM Same game. A bigger vision.  For entertainment purposes only. Please gamble responsibly.

title: Shadows of the Case
author: Anthony
description: Shadows of the Case explores the stories behind real criminal investigations, mysterious disappearances, unsolved cases, and discoveries that changed the course of an investigation. Each episode examines the known facts, important evidence, investigative challenges, and unanswered questions surrounding a case. Through careful storytelling and a focus on verified information, the podcast takes listeners beyond the headlines to explore how investigators search for the truth. From overlooked clues to complex timelines, Shadows of the Case brings a thoughtful perspective to true crime stories while respecting the people and families affected by these events.

title: Ingresos y obligaciones de la LISR
author: Ana Herrera
description:
¡Hola! Bienvenidos a este podcast.

En esta ocasión hablaremos sobre algunos temas importantes de la legislación fiscal mexicana relacionados con las personas morales.Primero, explicaremos los tipos de ingresos que deben considerar las personas morales conforme a la Ley del Impuesto sobre la Renta. Después, hablaremos sobre el ajuste anual por inflación acumulable y deducible, y finalmente, conoceremos qué establecen los artículos 29 y 29-A del Código Fiscal de la Federación, así como algunas de las principales obligaciones fiscales de las empresas.

title: I Was Sick and You Visited Me
author: Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Los Angeles (ADLA)
description:
The ADLA Office for Divine Worship, together with the Healthcare Ministry in the Office of Life, Justice, and Peace, is producing a podcast series entitled “I Was Sick and You Visited Me.”
In each episode, the co-hosts of this podcast series will interview a different guest to explore various aspects of ministry to those who are sick and vulnerable. Topics will include ministry to the sick, the accompaniment of people living with mental illness and addictions, the support of family members and caregivers, the Sacraments of Healing, and many other dimensions of compassionate and pastoral care.

title: The Far Lantern
author: Night Passage Studios
description:
Bedtime stories for curious adults, told without ads or hurry.

The Far Lantern began as a little project for our family.

We wanted something to listen to at the end of the day. Interesting stories, told gently, that could carry us somewhere else for a while without demanding that we stay awake to hear the ending.

So we started making our own.

Stories about explorers, scientists, forgotten places, extraordinary discoveries, and ordinary people living through remarkable times. Sometimes there's a curious character, an unexpected friendship, or even a little scandal. History, after all, is full of people being people.

Meticulously crafted from human imagination, curiosity, love, and attention to detail.

Our narrator, Laurence, is an AI-generated voice we've carefully shaped to create the storytelling experience we'd always hoped to hear.

Eventually, we wondered whether other people might enjoy these stories too.

So here they are.

The Far Lantern is free to listen to, with no advertisements waiting to interrupt your sleep. If you'd like to help keep the lantern burning, you're warmly invited to support Night Passage Studios on Patreon. Our supporters help cover the costs of making these stories and, from time to time, get a little say in which curious paths we explore next.

Keep the lantern burning:

https://www.patreon.com/nightpassagestudios

Otherwise, just listen. That's why we made them.

Pull up a chair. The fire is warm, the lantern is lit, and there's time for one more story.

Capital Moves is a podcast for business owners exploring what's next — IPO, private equity, or simply understanding the path to outside capital.

author: Aiden
description: The Digital Frontier explores the technology transforming how we live, work, communicate, and understand the world. From artificial intelligence and cybersecurity to smart devices and emerging innovations, every episode explains complex technological ideas in simple, engaging language. Discover the opportunities, challenges, and possibilities shaping our digital future through original discussions designed for curious minds. Whether you are interested in modern inventions or the next generation of technology, The Digital Frontier brings the connected world closer to you.

author: Locked On Podcast Network
description: Your daily hit of Phoenix Suns covering news, trade rumors, game reactions, and sharp takes on everything happening with your team, all in five minutes or less. Done before your coffee is. New hits drop throughout the day, every day, all year long. Your Team. Every Day.

title: WhoCrime: True Crime Stories
author: WhoCrime
description:
WhoCrime: True Crime Stories takes you inside real murder cases, disappearances, suspicious deaths, criminal investigations, and shocking crimes you may have never heard about.
Each episode uncovers the people, evidence, timelines, investigations, arrests, courtroom developments, and unanswered questions behind real true crime cases from across the United States and beyond.
From murders and missing persons to family tragedies, cold cases, mysterious deaths, and cases involving suicide, WhoCrime tells each story through detailed documentary-style narration while keeping the focus on the r

author: The Legacy Dialogues by TQM Wealth Partners

title: Autism in the ED
author: Bassam Nuseibeh
description:
What does an emergency department feel like through the eyes of an autistic patient? And how can we improve that experience?

Hosted by Hamish and Jeremy, Autism in the ED shares the experiences and insights of Dr Bassam Nuseibeh, a practising Emergency Medicine physician and proud father of a wonderful autistic child.

Blending personal stories with clinical insights, this podcast challenges assumptions, offers practical strategies and helps healthcare professionals deliver safer, kinder and more inclusive emergency care.

title: Cisco Security from the Network Outward
author: Katherine Blough
description:
What if your network infrastructure could help defend itself against cyberattacks—even before a software vulnerability is permanently patched?

In the premiere episode of Cisco Security from the Network Outward, we explore how eBPF, Tetragon, and Cisco Live Protect are changing the way we think about protecting network infrastructure.

We'll break down how eBPF enables programmable capabilities within the Linux kernel, how Tetragon uses those capabilities for runtime security and observability, and how Cisco Live Protect brings targeted vulnerability mitigation to supported Cisco Smart Switches.

In this episode, you'll discover:

  • eBPF explained: What it is, how it works, and why it's becoming an important technology in modern cybersecurity.

  • Inside Tetragon: How runtime observability and enforcement help identify and control potentially malicious behavior.

  • Cisco Live Protect: How CVE-specific Shields can help mitigate supported vulnerabilities while organizations prepare permanent software updates.

  • Monitor versus Enforce: Why observing suspicious behavior is different from actively blocking it.

  • The bigger picture: How these technologies fit into Cisco's evolving approach to integrating security directly into network infrastructure.

Whether you're a network engineer, cybersecurity professional, solutions architect, or Cisco partner, this episode provides a practical foundation for understanding how security is moving deeper into the network.

Coming up next: We'll take a closer look at what actually happens when an attacker attempts to exploit a vulnerability protected by a Cisco Live Protect Shield.

author: Austin Marchese

author: Relationships Australia NSW

Why connection and relationships matter so much to our wellbeing – and what often gets in the way.


Are We Good? is a podcast about the relationships we depend on but don’t always know how to navigate. Join host Marina Pliatsikas for honest conversations, personal stories and expert insights into how we connect with partners, friends, family and the people around us.

author: Alex Smith
description: Above the Rimline explores the excitement, strategy, and stories that make basketball unforgettable. From incredible performances and intense rivalries to teamwork, game-changing decisions, and last-second shots, each episode takes listeners closer to the action. Discover what happens beyond the scoreboard and learn how dedication, skill, and determination shape the game. Whether you follow basketball every day or are just getting into the sport, Above the Rimline brings you closer to the moments that matter.

author: Aspersed Asparagus

Perspective Drift is a podcast where we discuss how the stories and media we interact with make us who we are. Each episode, Chris and Chuck sit down to discuss a piece of media that had an impact on one of them and the circumstances around its impact.

author: Gerryn Hussain

Welcome to GH Connects: The Lounge.

author: victor
description: Nine Innings Later takes you beyond the scoreboard to explore the excitement, strategy, and stories that make baseball special. title: What Catholics Believe--and Why
author: John M
description: The Catholic faith is meant to lead us somewhere — to union with God and eternal life. What Catholics Believe — and Why explores the great truths of the faith with that destination in mind. Through book studies, Scripture, the Catechism, encyclicals and timely topics, we go beyond the surface to understand what the Church teaches, why it teaches it, and how it all fits together. Our first series is based on Frank Sheed’s classic book, Theology and Sanity.

author: Hunchline Football

title: Good Hang with Amy Poehler
author: vdf
description: Come hang with Amy Poehler. Each week on her podcast, she'll welcome celebrities and fun people to her studio. They'll share stories about their careers, mutual friends, shared enthusiasms, and most importantly, what's been making them laugh. This podcast is not about trying to make you better or giving advice. Amy just wants to have a good time.

title: The Winning Edge
author: Carter
description: The Winning Edge explores the stories, struggles, and decisions that shape the world of sports. From the discipline behind great performances to the pressure of competition, this podcast looks beyond the final score to discover what it takes to keep improving. Each episode explores athletic determination, teamwork, memorable sporting moments, and the lessons that sports can teach us about handling challenges. Whether it is a close match, a remarkable comeback, or an athlete overcoming a difficult period, every story offers a different perspective on dedication and achievement. Join us as we explore the human side of competition and discover why success is about more than simply winning.

title: Go Boil the Water: Homebirth from the Partner’s Side

description:
Go Boil the Water is a podcast about homebirth from the partner’s side. I’m Noah Jenks, a dad of four and the author of Go Boil the Water: A Partner’s Guide to Supporting Homebirth.
When my wife Katie told me she wanted a homebirth, I had no idea what my job was. Most of what’s out there is written for moms, which makes sense, but it left me guessing. So I started asking around. title: Southern Family Investigations Podcast
author: SoFamInvPodcast
description:
Welcome to the Southern Family Investigations Podcast, where we have three generations of family members diving headfirst into mysteries, folk stories, urban legends, and unexplained history.  From deep-rooted Southern Lore to bizarre local accounts, as a family, we will look at the history, review the scientific findings, and break it all down together.  

Full of heavy Southern accents, three generations of viewpoints, and a whole lot of family banter, we piece together the stories and records to reach our own wild conclusions. Plug in and get ready for a hot mess of an investigation.

title: Dan Snow's History Hit
author: BHY
description:
Historian Dan Snow journeys across the globe to tell the stories of history's defining moments. From the Colosseum in Rome to the Great Wall of China, the battlefields of Waterloo to the Tomb of Tutankhamun, join Dan as he explores the how and why of the greatest monuments, battles, heroes, villains and events that have shaped our world.
New episodes on Mondays and Thursdays with bonus subscriber only episodes every other Friday.
You can get in touch with us at ds.hh@historyhit.com

Sign up to History Hit for hundreds of hours of original documentaries, with a new release every week and ad-free podcasts. Sign up at https://www.historyhit.com/subscribe.

title: Gen Z Stars
author: Tarana
description:
Gen Z Stars, hosted by Sonal Sharma, is a podcast created to shine a spotlight on the incredible young people making their mark across New Zealand.
From sports and music to arts, culture, education, entrepreneurship and other fields of expertise, the podcast gives Gen Z talent an opportunity to share their journey, achievements, challenges and dreams.
There are so many talented young people living in New Zealand whose stories are inspiring, motivating and worth celebrating. Yet, many of these young achievers rarely receive attention because their journeys don’t always make it into mainstream news.
That’s where Gen Z Stars comes in.
Through this podcast, Tarana will connect with young New Zealanders who are doing remarkable things — giving them a platform to tell their own stories, share their experiences and inspire others from their generation.
Hosted by Sonal Sharma, each episode will go beyond the achievements to discover the person behind the talent — their passion, determination, struggles, successes and what motivates them to keep chasing their goals.
Whether they are rising stars in sport, creative artists, performers, young entrepreneurs, academic achievers or simply young people making a positive difference in their communities, Gen Z Stars is about celebrating their voices and showing that extraordinary talent can be found everywhere.
Because every young person has a story — and Tarana wants to help share those stories with New Zealand.
 Gen Z Stars with Sonal Sharma — celebrating the next generation of talent, one inspiring story at a time.

title: Within Reach with Doug Blackburn
author: Doug Blackburn
description:
**Within Reach — Real Conversations About Faith, Life, and Following Jesus**
Faith doesn't have to be complicated, and you don't have to have everything figured out to begin a relationship with Jesus.
Welcome to *Within Reach*, hosted by Doug Blackburn — a regular guy with an imperfect past, a personal story of transformation, and a passion for sharing the hope found in Jesus Christ.
Through honest conversations, personal experiences, biblical wisdom, and a little humor, we explore the questions that matter: Who is Jesus? What does it really mean to be a Christian?

title: Being Centered with Rais Tuluka
author: Rais Tuluka
description: Being Centered with Rais Tuluka is a podcast about attention, creativity, leadership, and the inner work of becoming who you are meant to be. Through reflections on culture, writing, discipline, spirituality, and modern life, Rais Tuluka offers thoughtful conversations for people trying to live with greater clarity, purpose, and depth.

title: VO Infusion
author: Deb Munro & Keith Norton
description:
AI is already in the booth, and most voice actors are getting their information about it from rumors, headlines and contract fine print. VO Infusion is where two working voice actors, Deb Munro and Keith Norton, sit down and sort out what’s real. We talk through the tools, the synthetic voice deals, the contracts and the protections that groups like NAVA and CAVA are pushing for, and we do it in plain English.
Deb brings the energy and a little creative chaos, while Keith shows up with the questions and a healthy dose of skepticism. Together we’re trying to help voice actors understand AI well enough to make their own calls about it, without the doom and without the hype.
New episodes come out in audio and video. Whether you’re booking your first jobs or you’ve been behind the mic for years, you’ll leave each episode knowing more than when you started.

title: CoworkingView Office Notes
author: CoworkingView
description:
Short, practical notes on renting private offices, coworking desks and office space in Berlin, Hamburg, London, Madrid and Barcelona. From CoworkingView, the office marketplace that is free of commission for tenants. No hype, just what teams should know before they sign. https://coworkingview.com

In deze podcastserie nemen wij de luisteraar mee in de wereld van het edelhert in Nederland (en daarbuiten) en de bezigheden van de vereniging om de edelhertenpopulatie te ondersteunen.

Charge Talk is your go-to source for an electrifying look at the future of transportation. In each episode, we're delving into the latest advances in the EV space, spotlighting cutting edge tech, sustainable initiatives and the incredible people steering us towards a greener future.

Joel from Baltimore and Kip from Texas come together for real, unfiltered conversations about life, relationships, culture, current events, and everything in between.
Sometimes we agree. Sometimes we challenge each other. And sometimes the conversation takes a turn neither of us saw coming.
No rehearsed opinions. No forced arguments. Just genuine friendship, different perspectives, and conversations worth having.
Different backgrounds. Real conversations. No script.
You hear me, though?

title: Confessions of a Medicine Woman
author: Maria Gingras
description:
Healing doesn't live in perfection. It lives in the TRUTH. I'm a Registered Nurse & a medicine woman. A shamanic practitioner, an intuitive medium, a woman who has fallen apart & rebuilt herself from the ashes- many, many times. And here's what I know: the most powerful medicine I carry isn't found in a ceremony or a chart. It's found in being fully, unapologetically HUMAN. Vulnerability & authenticity are two facets of my embodied medicine. When I speak my truth, the messy, the sacred, the heartbreaking, & the holy, I give you permission to speak yours. title: Day One Discipleship

On the Day One Discipleship Podcast, Bill Brunson opens a passage of Scripture in each episode. author: Learn About Islam

What does it actually take to choose a university today? Beyond glossy view-books and scripted campus tours lies a complex maze of search fatigue, application friction, financial trade-offs, and shifting definitions of higher-ed ROI.


The Campus Media Network Podcast, powered by PodcastVideos.com, pulls back the curtain on the modern college shopper journey. Through unfiltered conversations with real students and parents, we track the exact moments a university moves from an option on paper to a final enrollment decision.

title: Mystery। Old Time Radio
author: Old Time Radio
description: Mystery | Old Time Radio brings you classic mystery, suspense, and thrilling detective stories from the golden age of radio. Enjoy timeless radio dramas filled with strange secrets, unexpected twists, and unforgettable adventures. Step into the past and experience the magic of vintage mystery entertainment.

title: Heart To Heart.ttu

description: Welcome, everyone, to Heart to Heart, the show that fills your heart with good vibes, happy news, fun games, and the best underground sounds! We are a radio show on KTXT 88.1 The Radio FM at Texas Tech University.

author: David Ondrej

David Ondrej covers AI agents and practical ways to build with the latest AI tools and models.

Links:
Cloudroom: https://cloudroom.dev
Twitter: https://twitter.com/DavidOndrej1

title: Crime Uncovered
author: Daniel Reuben
description:
Welcome to Crime Uncovered – Your Front Row Seat to the World’s Most Twisted Stories! From the chilling tales of Deadly Women to the dark depths of Inside The Mind of a Serial Killer, Crime Uncovered reveals the shocking, real-life stories that haunt headlines. Whether you're fascinated by criminal psychology, love unraveling mysteries, or can’t resist gripping crime shows, this is your ultimate destination for all things true crime. What are you waiting for? Subscribe now and start watching! Crime Uncovered has it all.

title: Now We're Talkin'
author: Access Church

Through honest conversations, meaningful stories, and practical insights, we explore what it looks like to live out our faith beyond Sunday mornings and bring God into our everyday world. From navigating life’s challenges to discovering purpose, growing in faith, and experiencing the power of God’s grace, each episode is an opportunity to hear how real people are being changed by God and how those stories can inspire transformation in our own lives. Because sometimes, the conversations we have can change the way we see God, ourselves, and the world around us.

title: Before the Beat

description: Music has never stopped changing, and every generation has left its own sound behind. Before the Beat explores the fascinating evolution of modern music, from the early days of recorded sound and the rise of rock 'n' roll to hip-hop, electronic beats, and today's streaming culture. Each episode looks at the artists, technologies, cultural movements, and creative ideas that helped shape the music people listen to today. Discover how musical styles developed, how recording changed the listening experience, and why certain sounds became part of everyday life. Whether you enjoy the classics or follow the latest musical trends, this podcast takes you behind the sound to explore the stories that shaped modern music, one era at a time

title: Pod Alive
author: Church Alive
description:
Pod Alive is a space for honest conversations about faith, leadership, and everyday life with Jesus.
Through real stories and relaxed dialogue, we explore what it means to live fully alive—together. Whether you’re leading, learning, rebuilding, or just beginning your journey, this podcast exists to encourage and equip people of all ages to walk with Christ in real life.
This is more than content.
This is community.
Welcome to Pod Alive.

title: Best Version of You Podcast
author: Best Version of You
description:
Faith. Growth. Purpose. Real Conversations. 🎙️

Welcome to Best Version of You, hosted by husband-and-wife duo Kayla and Mack. Through honest, thought-provoking conversations about faith, marriage, personal development, and business, we explore what it truly means to grow into who God created us to be.

From navigating life's challenges to pursuing purpose and building meaningful relationships, we're sharing real experiences, fresh perspectives, and lessons learned along the way.

New episodes every Wednesday!

Because becoming your best version is a lifelong journey.

title: Austen & Eden
author: Noelle Mceachran
description:
Lasting stories follow the same patterns. From classic fairy tales down to C.S. Lewis, Harry Potter, and, of course, Jane Austen, the great stories carry timeless motifs.


These patterns are the hidden reasons we love a good story without knowing why. They slip past our defenses, speak to the soul, and shape who we become.

This podcast is for you if you love Jane Austen but don't want to stop there. Austen is our open door into deeper storytelling. Into the kinds of stories that go all the way back to a garden.

title: A Wonderful Shitty Podcast
author: Jonnah
description:
An honest little podcast about the wonderful and shitty parts of being human.

Conversations about life, creativity, spirituality, self-discovery, and everything we're still figuring out. Sometimes philosophical, sometimes personal, sometimes just sitting somewhere beautiful and talking about whatever comes to mind.

No perfect answers. No need to pretend we've got it all figured out. Just a little space to slow down, reflect, laugh at the mess, and find meaning in the middle of it all.

Come as you are. Take what resonates. Leave what doesn't.

Have a wonderful shitty day and life 💜

- JONNAH

title: Eagles 5 in 5
author: Ten Minutes of Stillness

Marcus and Dana run through the five biggest stories in Eagles football every morning, seven days a week — injuries, lineup moves, game breakdowns, and what's coming next — so you're caught up before your coffee cools. Fast, fresh, and flying.

author: Rahul G. Iyer

author: L.M. Montgomery
description:
A heartwarming classic romance from the beloved author of Anne of Green Gables, about a woman who decides, at last, to live life on her own terms.

Valancy Stirling is twenty-nine, unmarried, and utterly overlooked. She lives under the thumb of her domineering mother and a judgmental family in a small Ontario town, escaping only into daydreams of her imaginary Blue Castle. Then a doctor's letter tells her she has only a year to live – and Valancy stops being afraid. She speaks her mind, scandalizes her relatives, leaves home, and makes a bold choice that leads her to the wild lakes and forests of Muskoka and to the mysterious, much-gossiped-about Barney Snaith.

First published in 1926, The Blue Castle is one of Lucy Maud Montgomery's few novels written for adults, and today it is a cult favorite among readers who love slow-burn romance, found freedom, nature writing, and gentle humor. Often called the perfect comfort read, it is a story about courage, self-discovery, and finding joy in an ordinary life.

title: FND Doesn't Define Me – My Life, My Rules! | USA Youth Edition
author: Paul Edwards & Jennifer Kerr
description:
🎙️ FND Doesn't Define Me – My Life, My Rules! | USA Youth Edition

 

Your diagnosis is part of your story. It doesn't define who you are!


Welcome to a special youth-focused podcast created by UK-based FND advocates Paul Edwards from the West Midlands, England, and Jennifer Kerr from Scotland, as part of their continued international Functional Neurological Disorder (FND) awareness work.


Created especially for children, teenagers and young adults across the United States, this podcast delivers a powerful message of hope, friendship, individuality and empowerment. Living with FND can bring challenges, but it should never mean that a young person is defined solely by their medical condition.


From elementary school to college, friendships to gaming, music to sports, and hobbies to future ambitions, we explore why every young person deserves opportunities to enjoy life, feel included and pursue their dreams. We don't pretend that living with FND is always easy. Instead, we encourage understanding, compassion, appropriate support and opportunities for young people to enjoy life at their own pace.


🌎 Two UK advocates. One international mission.


Together, Paul Edwards and Jennifer Kerr are working to raise awareness, challenge misconceptions and create accessible, positive resources for the younger FND community. Whether you're living with FND, supporting someone who is, or simply wanting to understand more, you're welcome here.


✨ Be yourself. Have fun. Keep dreaming.

Because FND may be part of your story, but it will NEVER be your whole story!


Created and presented by Paul Edwards & Jennifer Kerr.

Produced specifically for children, teens and young adults in the United States.

🌎 FND HAS NO BORDERS!


Educational and awareness content only. This podcast does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

Born out of the relentless energy of 604 Records—Canada's largest independent label that's been breaking boundaries since 2002—this series goes beyond the surface to explore the unvarnished truths of the music world. Each episode is a raw, unfiltered conversation with the artists who've fought their way to the top, supported by a label that knows what it means to hustle.With 604 Records' legacy of nurturing groundbreaking talent and challenging the status quo, "Verses" pulls back the curtain on the grind of building a fan base, the daring evolution of sound, and the intense pressure of releasing new music. This is where the stories get real, the insights get deep, and the lessons are hard-earned. If you're ready to hear from the artists who don't just follow trends—they set them—subscribe now. "604 Records Presents: Verses" is where the indie spirit lives loud, and the music industry's toughest truths are revealed.

Welcome to NIGHTMARE PULSE, your destination for terrifying horror stories, psychological nightmares, paranormal encounters, unexplained mysteries, disturbing urban legends, and chilling tales that will make you question everything you thought you knew about the darkness. Here, fear has a heartbeat. Step into abandoned hospitals where footsteps echo through empty corridors. Discover forgotten houses hiding unspeakable secrets. Listen to stories of strangers who vanished without a trace, mysterious figures watching from the shadows, and unexplained encounters that challenge the boundaries between reality and imagination. From deep psychological horror to supernatural phenomena, every story is designed to pull you into an atmosphere of suspense, dread, and uncertainty. Expect unexpected twists, haunting revelations, eerie environments, and moments that will stay with you long after the story ends. Whether you love terrifying short stories, dark mysteries, paranormal investigations, disturbing true crime tales, or fictional nightmares crafted to test your courage, NIGHTMARE PULSE brings you closer to the fears that live in the darkest corners of the human mind. Our mission is simple: to transform ordinary nights into unforgettable experiences of terror. So turn off the lights. Put on your headphones. Let the silence surround you, and prepare to enter a world where every sound feels suspicious and every shadow tells a different story. Subscribe to NIGHTMARE PULSE and become part of a community that dares to explore the unknown. Because when the world falls silent, something else begins to breathe. NIGHTMARE PULSE — FEEL THE FEAR. HEAR THE DARKNESS. Enter if you dare. Stay if you can.

description:
Кажется, ещё вчера вы прекрасно понимали своего ребёнка. А сегодня он не хочет учиться, часами сидит в телефоне, спорит по любому поводу и отвечает на все вопросы: «Нормально». Что происходит? И как теперь с ним разговаривать?

Each episode brings together educators and communicators to discuss the transformative impact of oracy in schools and the lessons it offers beyond the classroom.

title: Unicode Character Mapping - Fontgenly
author: Fontgenly
description:
In this episode, we explore how modern client-side web tools perform real-time character transformation from standard ASCII (U+0021–U+007E) to Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols (U+1D400–U+1D7FF). 
By leveraging browser-level JavaScript execution and character code offsets, utilities can render Mathematical Bold, Script, Italic, and Monospace styles without external web fonts, custom CSS, or server-side latency.
Try the zero-dependency live utility:
font changer
Key Topics Covered:
- Standard ASCII vs. Unicode Supplementary Multilingual Plane
- Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols range (U+1D400–U+1D7FF)
- Eliminating layout shift and font download overhead
- Generating copy-pasteable typography for social media bios

Bring us along while you fold the washing, do the school pick-up or drive between one thing and the next. This is a circle of women seeing women: in our laughter, our exhaustion, our contradictions and our healing. Nobody here has the answers, and that's the point. Mostly, we're here for the moments of "oh, me too."

No performance. No perfection. Just honest connection, one cup of tea at a time.

title: The Bambi Trap
author: Tattle Productions
description:
Somewhere in the depths of the internet, a secretive collection of audio files promises something extraordinary: the ability to rewrite who you are. They call it Bambi Sleep.


For some, it's fantasy. For others, an escape. But for those who venture deeper, the lines between pleasure, identity and control can begin to disappear. Who created these mys

terious recordings? What happens to the people who surrender themselves to them? And why do some claim they can never truly escape?


In this five-part investigative documentary, Host Rhys Waters follows a trail of anonymous creators, devoted listeners, disturbing testimonies and extraordinary claims into a world where reality and suggestion become difficult to separate. What begins as an investigation into an obscure internet phenomenon soon raises unsettling questions about consent, manipulation and the power of the human mind.

Is Bambi Sleep an elaborate fantasy, a dangerous experiment in psychological control, or something we don't yet have the language to understand?


There's only one way to find out. Put on your headphones. And listen.

title: The Xennial Man
author: thexennialmanpod
description:
Grew up on analog, living in digital, and juggling everything in between? Welcome home.
Remember when we used to spend entire days conversing exclusively in Simpsons quotes? Or feeling like the coffee table felt naked without the latest copy of EW? Keep up with us as we bring our 90s kids perspectives to pop culture and sports.
Multiple days a week, we deliver a sharp, 15-to-20-minute magazine-style show tailored for Xennial men with a dose of ”Financial Zen” to keep your money mindset grounded despite crazy news cycles.
Think of it like your old coffee table reads: quick, and insightful, but now built for your schedule.
Hit follow and start your day informed.

title: The Collision Point
author: Ashley Sterken | Fractional COO For Mom Founders
description:
Welcome to The Collision Point — the podcast about ambition and motherhood, and what happens when the two collide.

Your host, Ashley, is a former corporate COO turned two-time founder, and she’s living this collision right alongside you.

For years, Ashley built her career using the only playbook she knew: work harder, produce more, push through, and keep going until it works. And for a long time, it did. Until she became a mother and suddenly, the playbook that had built her success stopped working overnight.

She didn’t have the language for it then. She called it burnout. She pushed harder. Until eventually, her body made the decision for her.

Now, Ashley sees the collision differently.

Because ambition doesn’t disappear when you become a mother. But the way you pursue it might have to change.

The Collision Point is a space for the judgment, the burnout, the identity shifts, the days that fall apart despite your perfectly planned schedule, and the uncomfortable moments when the life you’re building no longer fits the way you’ve been building it.

Because collisions don’t get solved once and disappear. But they can become fewer, less costly, and less invisible when you stop trying to operate exactly like you did before.

This is about building careers, businesses, and lives that make room for your real life to happen, not ones that break every time it does.

If you’re ambitious, you’re a mother, or you’re somewhere in the collision between the two, you’re in the right place.

title: The Faraway Places
author: Max Hills
description: Welcome to The Faraway Places, a travel podcast that takes you beyond familiar streets and popular tourist destinations to discover the extraordinary world around us. From peaceful coastal villages and remote mountain communities to vibrant cities, ancient landmarks, and breathtaking natural landscapes, every episode brings a new destination to life. We explore local traditions, regional food, fascinating histories, and the people who give each place its unique character. Whether you dream of travelling across continents, discovering hidden corners of the world, or simply learning about places you have never visited, this podcast offers a fresh perspective on travel and discovery. Pack your curiosity and join us on a journey where every destination has a story, every culture offers something new, and the world always has another place waiting to be explored.
